title: Closest function satisfying a property
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a finite set, let $f:\Omega\to\beta$, and let $P$ be a property of functions from $\Omega$ to $\beta$. If at least one such function satisfies $P$, define a closest function satisfying $P$ to be a function chosen among those satisfying $P$ that minimizes the relative Hamming distance to $f$.
